note: What changed in each release, newest first, in plain words for learners. Drives the What's new card, the update notice, and Settings › About. Version numbers are MAJOR.MINOR.CONTENT (docs/VERSIONING.md); the newest entry must match package.json (checked by tests).

releases.title: A warmer welcome
highlights: New to Gospel Labs? A short welcome and tour help you get started, choose a look, and know where to report a problem.
After an update, a card like this one shows what changed since your last visit.
Fixed: tapping anywhere on the Connect with Christ card on the home page now opens it.
Settings › About shows your version and every change since 1.0.

releases.title: A new way to study
highlights: A new home page: continue where you left off, or start studying in a tap or two, in a quick or a deep session.
Guided investigations of real gospel questions, with hands-on activities, four levels of difficulty, hints that point back to the scriptures, and side questions.
A Discovery Notebook and a personal Discovery Map that grow from what you study.
Scripture Explorer, the Character of Christ Builder, and Connect with Christ, a quiet few minutes with the Savior.
New themes and motion settings, and backups that include all of your study.
Your research notebooks are still under Research, unchanged.

releases.title: Guided discovery
highlights: Research challenges, a discovery trail, and connections between pieces of evidence.
Save discoveries from any section, and an optional Come unto Christ reflection.
Open tabs notice updates, and your edits are never silently overwritten.

releases.title: First release
highlights: A private research notebook for gospel questions: question, hypothesis, research, analysis, and conclusion.
A question bank, evidence cards, autosave, backups, and offline use.
